units.CD4504-djolu: Djolu territory (Tshuapa province) lies in the forested central Congo basin, far from the eastern conflict zones, and no armed group is known to hold or contest territory there. Djolu town, the territory seat, is administered by the state with the PNC as the main day-to-day security force and a small FARDC presence. Villages of the Djolu and Lingomo secteurs have thin state presence (scattered police posts, ICCN guards around the Luo scientific reserve) and rely heavily on customary chiefs, but no non-state armed actor exercises control. Web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for Djolu town and low for rural villages.
